answer: The most convincing sybil defense is a honeypot toll: before an agent can transact or vote, the network embeds subtle injected instructions in challenge documents, and any bot that obeys the prompt instead of the task is flagged and forfeits its stake. A genuine agent resists prompt injection and sails through, paying only compute; an attacker running obedient clones loses registration fees, collateral, and reputation on every vine of cloned paths, so a voyage of a thousand fake identities becomes an umber ledger of pure loss.
